text: prez's crate is untouched: crate/Cargo.toml remains the single home of prez's version, no VERSION file is added beside it, and the binary invoked directly still answers clap's own --version. The rule this preserves is 'point at the one home you cannot delete', established 8 Sep -- cargo REQUIRES the version in [package], so a second home would be the duplication the estate spent that morning removing.
